sentences.en: The long coastline of the city contains sand and gravel.
sentences.zh: 这个城市的漫长海岸线含有沙和砾石。

sentences.en: They are binding the gravel with cement to repair the road.
sentences.zh: 他们用水泥把碎石粘合起来修路。

sentences.en: It's easy to lose your footing on loose gravel.
sentences.zh: 走在松软的碎石上很容易滑倒。

senses.zh: 用碎石铺；使船搁浅在沙滩上；使困惑
